footer.summary: VUM CRM helps businesses centralize customer data, control the pipeline, and run sales processes on one unified platform.

metadata.homeTitle: VUM CRM | Control the entire sales process
metadata.homeDescription: Centralize customer data and manage pipeline, quotes, contracts, and sales performance on a CRM platform for Vietnamese enterprises.
metadata.featuresTitle: VUM CRM Features | From lead to contract
metadata.featuresDescription: Explore how VUM CRM manages the full customer lifecycle, opportunities, quotes, contracts, automation, and data governance.
metadata.solutionsTitle: VUM CRM Solutions | Sales operations built around your business model
metadata.solutionsDescription: Standardize sales processes across regions, teams, and complex B2B cycles with centrally governed customer data.
metadata.pricingTitle: VUM CRM Services | Consultation based on operational needs
metadata.pricingDescription: Define the VUM CRM implementation scope based on team size, process complexity, and data-governance requirements.
metadata.demoDescription: Talk directly with the VUM team about your sales process, customer data, and an appropriate implementation scope.

hero.title: One system where the sales team works from the same data and follows the same process.
hero.description: Bring customer records, opportunities, quotes, contracts, and service activities together so leaders can see revenue clearly while the team focuses on the next action.

problem.eyebrow: From scattered data to an operating system
problem.title: Your business does not need another report. It needs a trustworthy source of data for action.
beforeItems: Customer information lives in many files and with many people
The pipeline is updated only before review meetings
Quotes, contracts, and conversation history are disconnected
problem.afterTitle: When operations run on VUM CRM
afterItems: Every account has one unified profile and timeline
Every opportunity is tracked by stage, owner, and next action
Leaders see the same data the team uses every day

capabilities.title: Stay with the customer from the first signal through post-contract service
capabilities.customer360Title: One customer profile with complete context
capabilities.customer360Description: Connect organizations, contacts, activities, documents, and lifecycle status in one view.
capabilities.pipelineTitle: A pipeline that reflects real work
capabilities.pipelineDescription: Track value, probability, timing, and the next action for every opportunity instead of waiting for an end-of-period summary.
capabilities.automationTitle: Processes keep moving while the team is busy
capabilities.automationDescription: Standardize assignment, reminders, approvals, and alerts so opportunities are not lost between steps.

roles.title: Each role sees what it needs to make a decision
roles.executiveTitle: See revenue and risk from the same source of data
executiveItems: Identify regions or stages where work is blocked
Review performance without waiting for manual reports
roles.managerTitle: Know which opportunities need support before it is too late
managerItems: Find opportunities with no next activity
Coach with evidence from each pipeline stage
roles.salesTitle: Spend less time updating and more time with customers
salesItems: Manage calls, meetings, and next tasks
Create quotes from product catalogs and price books
Review the full interaction history before every contact

trust.title: Scale the team without giving up control of customer data
items: Data scope by organization and team

finalCta.title: Start with the process costing your business the most time.
finalCta.description: The VUM team will review your current customer flow, pipeline, and data before recommending an implementation scope.

features.heroKicker: The customer lifecycle on one platform
features.heroTitle: From first lead to contract and post-sale service
features.heroDescription: VUM CRM connects the steps your teams perform every day so data stays intact across marketing, sales, operations, and service.

lead.title: Capture and qualify leads
lead.description: Record source, owner, contact status, and conversion criteria.

account.title: Build Account and Contact 360° profiles
account.description: Centralize company details, contacts, relationships, addresses, channels, and activity history.

opportunity.title: Manage opportunities through the pipeline
opportunity.description: Track stage, value, probability, expected date, and next action.

commerce.title: Connect opportunities with quotes, orders, and contracts
commerce.description: Preserve commercial context from proposal through delivery commitment.

automation.title: Standardize reminders and workflows
automation.description: Combine activities, notifications, and pipeline configuration so the team works consistently.

forecast.title: Track forecasts and performance
forecast.description: Aggregate opportunity data so leaders and managers can assess revenue progress.

governance.title: Control permissions, scope, and access history
governance.description: Apply roles, data scope, privacy controls, and audit logs within the same platform.

features.ctaTitle: See VUM CRM work with your business process

solutions.heroTitle: CRM should fit how your organization works and makes decisions
solutions.heroDescription: Instead of applying one template to every industry, VUM starts with your organization structure, sales cycle, and data-governance requirements.

regional.title: Regional teams with multiple management levels
regional.description: Assign customers, track performance, and limit data by organization, region, and team.

b2b.title: Long B2B sales cycles with multiple stakeholders
b2b.description: Preserve context from contacts, opportunities, and quotes through orders and contracts.

governed.title: Operations that require integration and traceability
governed.description: Connect data through imports, webhooks, and integration records while maintaining audit logs and privacy controls.

pricing.heroKicker: An implementation scope based on real needs
pricing.heroTitle: Service scope based on how your business operates
pricing.heroDescription: VUM assesses team size, process complexity, and governance requirements before proposing an appropriate scope and cost.

process.description: The number of pipelines, approval steps, quotes, contracts, and service flows to standardize.

integration.title: Data and integrations
integration.description: The data sources to migrate, systems to connect, and synchronization requirements.

governance.title: Governance and implementation support
governance.description: Permissions, audit, privacy, training, operations, and the required support level.

pricing.includedTitle: Every consultation scope starts with the core platform
